title: Write Markdown Once, Publish It Everywhere: dev.to, Medium, AWS Builder Center and LinkedIn
why_read: A practical walkthrough of a markdown multi-platform publishing tool built as an agent skill, useful mainly to content creators managing cross-posting workflows.
analysis: This article describes 'publishing-kit,' a tool built as a Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity agent skill that takes one markdown file and formats, checks, and publishes it across dev.to, Medium, AWS Builder Center, and LinkedIn, each of which renders markdown differently and some lack publishing APIs entirely. It's a reasonably practical solution to a real annoyance for technical writers who cross-post content, handling formatting differences and verifying each platform's output before posting. The technical depth is modest, mostly API integration and format conversion, but it addresses a concrete and relatable workflow pain point.
